tagline: Model it once. Ask in one sentence.
brief: Self-hosted, open-source BI for analysts who build the semantic model themselves, then describe the analysis and let the AI write the page. It should feel precise, technical and calm — not another AI sparkle.
criteria: Success: ownable letterform, reads as data without drawing a dashboard, clear at 16 px, works in one colour, keeps the amber equity.

concepts.name: Radial C
concepts.idea: The C is a radial bar chart: your initial, drawn as data.
rationale: Letterform tied to the name, so it can't be borrowed
Three bands = model, query, page — never spelled out
One filled shape: holds at 16 px with its own small cut

recommendation: Radial C, amber on light and gold on dark, with Geist Sans outlined for the wordmark.
next_steps: Trademark and reverse-image search before public launch
Replace outdated README screenshots alongside the new mark
